targets.rawSql:
WITH folded AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', r.started_at) AS 날짜,
         r.run_id, i.tc_id, i.platform,
         bool_and(i.status = 'PASS') AS passed
  FROM run_item i
  JOIN test_run r ON r.run_id = i.run_id
  WHERE r.started_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
    AND i.unconfirmed IS NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
)
SELECT 날짜 AS time,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE passed) / count(*), 1) AS "성공률"
FROM folded
GROUP BY 날짜
ORDER BY 날짜

SELECT date_trunc('day', r.started_at) AS time,
       round(avg(i.duration_ms)) AS "평균 소요시간"
FROM run_item i
JOIN test_run r ON r.run_id = i.run_id
WHERE r.started_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND i.duration_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH folded AS (
  SELECT i.tc_id, max(i.tc_name) AS tc_name,
         bool_or(i.status = 'FAIL') AS failed
  FROM run_item i
  JOIN test_run r ON r.run_id = i.run_id
  WHERE r.started_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
    AND i.unconfirmed IS NULL
  GROUP BY i.run_id, i.tc_id, i.platform
)
SELECT tc_id AS "케이스 ID",
       max(tc_name) AS "케이스명",
       count(*) AS "실패 건수"
FROM folded
WHERE failed
GROUP BY tc_id
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, tc_id
LIMIT 10

SELECT r.run_id AS "실행 번호",
       r.title AS "제목",
       r.service_name AS "서비스",
       r.env AS "대상 서버",
       r.status AS "상태",
       r.started_at AS "시작 시각"
FROM test_run r
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: 가장 오래된 미확정
panels.description: 기획 답을 기다리는 미확정 케이스. 나이는 카탈로그에 들어온 뒤부터다 — 초안 PR 이 열려 있던 기간은 들지 않는다. 활성 서비스·활성 케이스만 (도메인/리포팅 §8.5)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.name AS "서비스",
       count(*) AS "미확정 건수",
       floor(extract(epoch FROM now() - min(tc.unconfirmed_since)) / 86400)::int AS "카탈로그에 들어온 뒤 (일)"
FROM test_case tc
JOIN service s ON tc.tc_id LIKE s.prefix || '-%'
WHERE tc.is_active
  AND s.is_active
  AND tc.unconfirmed_since IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.id, s.name
ORDER BY min(tc.unconfirmed_since)

panels.title: 작성에 걸린 시간
panels.description: 최근 30일(끝난 시각)의 처음 작성 요청. 대기 = 요청을 만든 때부터 에이전트가 집을 때까지(자료 올리기·대기줄 포함), 작업 = 집은 때부터 끝날 때까지. 시간 칸은 성공한 것만, 실패는 따로 센다. 화면만 훑는 요청도 「화면과 대조」에 든다 (도메인/리포팅 §8.5)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.name AS "서비스",
       CASE WHEN a.compare THEN '화면과 대조' ELSE '보통' END AS "방식",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'DONE') AS "성공",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'FAILED') AS "실패",
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM a.started_at - a.created_at)::float8)
              FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'DONE') / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "대기 중간값 (분)",
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM a.finished_at - a.started_at)::float8)
              FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'DONE') / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "작업 중간값 (분)",
       round((max(extract(epoch FROM a.finished_at - a.started_at)) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'DONE') / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "작업 최대 (분)"
FROM authoring_request a
JOIN service s ON s.id = a.service_id
WHERE a.kind = 'AUTHOR'
  AND a.status IN ('DONE', 'FAILED')
  AND a.finished_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, a.compare
ORDER BY s.name, a.compare
